Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: A GitHub repository (ibm-granite/granite-4.2-language-models) lists the full training datasets; a technical blog, documentation, an HF collection of Granite 4.2 models, and an SGLang cookbook (deployment recipe) are also linked. The custom granite_thinking_parser is included in the model repository.
quotes: A full listing of training datasets is available in the [Granite 4.2 GitHub repository](https://github.com/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-language-models).
> **Reasoning parser:** Use the custom `granite_thinking_parser` included in this repository (requires vLLM v0.20+).

For a full deployment recipe (Docker, H200/B200 launch matrix, thinking-mode examples, and benchmark data), see the [SGLang Granite 4.2 cookbook](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/IBM/Granite-4.2).
